title: The Truth of the Sacrifice Revealed
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's fury churned within him, the ink-like patterns on the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly writhed violently—that pattern was identical to a fragment of memory he had lost in his childhood.

text.content: Night was as dark as ink, cold winds carried the sound of pine waves from the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, below was an abyss of ten thousand zhang, above was铅 clouds that blocked the stars and moon. Ye Qing's words still echoed in his ears—help the Demonic Path, in exchange for Chen Nian's slim chance at survival. This deal, he had yet to give an answer. Not that he couldn't answer, but that he didn't know how to. A chill rose from the depths, as if something was watching him from the darkness. The Tianji Record Fragment faintly burned hot, as if responding to something.

"You've come." A faint wisp of shadow drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's form was even more translucent than last time, as if a gust of wind could scatter it. His voice remained old and low, yet carried an unprecedented gravity. "I know what you're thinking—the Demonic woman's words have shaken you." Mo Xiansheng didn't look at Chen Ji, but gazed at the boundless night sky, as if he could pierce through the clouds to see some indescribable existence. "But what I must tell you weighs ten thousand times heavier than her conditions." Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, his voice cold: "Speak."

dialogue.content: "Do you know what a 'Heavenly Fate One' is?" Mo Xiansheng turned around, for the first time直视 Chen Ji's eyes. In those remnant soul eyes was something so profound it was suffocating. "Not every person who obtains the Tianji Record can become a Prophet. For millions of years, countless geniuses and talents have touched the Tianji Fragment, all died unnatural deaths. And you—" he paused, "you are the only one who has survived to recognize it as your master." Mo Xiansheng raised his hand, and a vague image emerged in the void: countless points of light scattered across the earth, connected by red threads, weaving an impenetrable net. "This is no coincidence. This is design."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that image, his heart sinking violently. Those points of light—he recognized a few. Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, White Tiger Sect, the positions of the three major sects matched precisely with those marked on the diagram. Additionally, there were dozens of factions he couldn't name, scattered about, interwoven with red threads of varying thickness. "This net..." his voice was somewhat hoarse. Mo Xiansheng nodded, his voice growing more low: "The entire cultivation world is a chessboard. And the so-called 'Sacrifice System' is the foundation that keeps this chessboard running."

dialogue.content: "Each generation of Prophets is the most critical piece on the chessboard." Mo Xiansheng raised his hand, and the image rapidly contracted, all light converging toward a central point—that point was precisely where Chen Ji stood. "Every time you use the foresight power of the Tianji Record, you are transmitting energy to some existence. For every 5 points of Heavenly Fate consumed, a strand of 'Dao Principle' is extracted and sent to a node in that net—and that node is the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao.'" Chen Ji suddenly clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white. He remembered those moments when his foresight became reality, remembered that bone-deep emptiness after every use of his ability. So from the very beginning, his power wasn't given freely. "What about my sister?" His voice was extremely low, almost挤出 from between his teeth. "What part of this net is her 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' identity?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a breath, his shadow growing even fainter. "She is the other core of the net. Do you think the Holy Sect took her for what?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and the image changed again. Beyond that great net, countless more magnificent points of light emerged—those points were ten times larger than the sects on the chessboard, emanating a pressure Chen Ji had never felt. And between the chessboard and those massive points of light, there were golden threads encircling the entire chessboard like a cage. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao..." For the first time, a subtle tremor appeared in Mo Xiansheng's voice. "It is not the endpoint. It is merely the eye of a higher existence." Chen Ji felt a chill rise from his tailbone straight to his fontanel. He thought he had touched the truth of this game, but unexpectedly—above the chessboard, there were Chess Players.

dialogue.content: "All previous generations of Prophets were completing the will of higher existences." Mo Xiansheng finished for him, an old voice tinged with sorrow. "Do you think why all previous Prophets走向crazed or death? Because they gradually discovered that what they were opposing was merely a puppet one level lower. The 'truth' the Eye of Heavenly Dao showed them was already filtered, incomplete fragments." He gazed at Chen Ji, his gaze complex. "And you, Chen Ji, are the first person to remain completely sane after obtaining the Tianji Record. This in itself is the greatest anomaly." Chen Ji猛地抬头, his eyes flashing with cold light: "What do you mean by that?" Mo Xiansheng smiled bitterly: "It means—from the moment you were born, you were already chosen. This net, this scheme, this so-called chaotic world—all were designed to push you to this position today."

text.content: This sentence exploded in Chen Ji's mind like a thunderclap. From his earliest memories, he had been a Servant Disciple of Tianqing Sect, bullied endlessly, surviving as atrash. He thought he had turned fate around by virtue of the Tianji Record Fragment, thought all the schemes and calculations were his own doing. But now Mo Xiansheng told him—even his "waste identity" might have been part of the design? "Impossible." His voice was cold as ice shards. "Every move I made was my own. No one could—"

dialogue.content: "No one?" Mo Xiansheng打断 him, his voice suddenly sharp. "Then let me ask you—when you were six years old, why did you pick up the first page of the Tianji Record on the Back Mountain? Among all the geniuses and talents of Tianqing Sect, why did thistrash have the chance to touch it? The Tianji Record always selects candidates with the highest Heavenly Fate, and your bone quality at that time—" hesneered, "was连凡人都不如." Chen Ji shuddered all over. Six years old. The Back Mountain. That memory fragment he thought long forgotten suddenly became clear—pitch-black cave, eerie green glow, and a warm hand placing something into his palm. That wasn't "found." That was—"Someone handed it to my young self." His voice lost composure for the first time,带着难以抑制的furious. "Who?!" Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his shadow growing ever fainter: "My memories are also being sealed. This answer, you must find yourself. But I can tell you one thing—that person is still watching you to this day."

text.content: Chen Ji spun around, his gaze sharp as a blade sweeping across the surrounding darkness. Pine waves howled, cold winds roared, nothing was there. But that sensation of being watched was so real, as if an invisible eye was pressed against the back of his head, coldly observing every trace of his emotions. Rage churned in his chest like a flood about to burst its banks. Everything about him from childhood to now—humiliation, forbearance, calculation, scheming—had merely been pre-placed pieces on someone else's chessboard? "Hah..." He suddenly let out a low laugh, the sound carrying indefinable bitterness and mockery. "What a grand design. Raise thistrash in the sect, raise him to eighteen, then let him obtain the Tianji Record, let him walk step by step to today—just for this very moment?"

dialogue.content: At this moment, a slight fluctuation came from the depths of the void. Not sound, but an意念 that directly灌入 his consciousness—cold, vast, irresistible. Chen Ji's hairs stood on end, that意念 he knew too well, precisely the will he vaguely sensed every time using the Tianji Record. The Eye of Heavenly Dao. It was watching him. "trash? Hmph..." That意念 coldly seeped into Chen Ji's Mental Sea,带着高高在上的漠视. "Do you think that warm hand you encountered on the Back Mountain at six years old was whose hand?" Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. That memory fragment—he had always thought it was illusion, a dream, but now considering it, that hand's touch was warm like no ordinary person's. "It was mine." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's意念 was terrifyingly calm. "You from the very beginning, are mine."

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. In his Mental Sea, a silent storm was occurring. Rage like magma surged through his veins, burning until his fingertips trembled. Yet at the same time, his near-cold理智 was rapidly operating—not resistance, not questioning, but calculating. The Eye of Heavenly Dao showing itself voluntarily—what did it mean? It meant its scheme had reached some critical node, requiring his cooperation or collapse. It was testing him. It was逼他表态. And the worst thing he could do right now was expose his true emotions. He took a deep breath, slowly raised his head, his lips actually pulling into a faint smile: "Since that's the case, then may I ask—what exactly is my sister Chen Nian to you?"

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's意念 was silent for a breath. That silence itself was the answer. "Lock Key." It finally spoke, its tone still indifferent. "When the chess game proceeds to the endgame, a key is needed to open the final door. Each generation of Prophets leaves a strand of remnant consciousness as the door's seal, and Chen Nian—" its意念 slightly fluctuated, as if smiling, "her soul structure is most compatible with yours. With her, you are the most perfect key. Without her, you are merely a piece of scrap iron that moves on its own." Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened. Chen Nian was a Lock Key—not a bargaining chip exploited by the Holy Sect, but a position the Eye of Heavenly Dao had set from the start. The Holy Sect was merely another piece in its hand. Ye Qing's deal was a joke from the beginning. "What if I don't cooperate?" His voice was terrifyingly calm.

text.content: "Not cooperate?" A hint of playfulness appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's意念. "Do you think you have a choice? From the moment you accepted the Tianji Record, every step of yours has been under my watch. Do you think why Ye Qing appeared near Tianqing Sect at that particular time? Do you think why Su Qingyao suddenly took interest in you? Do you think why Ling Yuan's 'protection' of you was出于好意?" Every sentence was like a heavy hammer striking Chen Ji's heart. He always thought he was the schemer, never expecting he was the one being schemed against from start to finish. All the pieces—Ye Qing, Su Qingyao, Ling Yuan—were nets laid by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and the chess game he thought he was weaving was merely desperate struggling within the net.

Chen Ji suddenly closed his eyes. Everything around seemed to freeze—wind stopped, insect chirps silenced, even that意念 of watching seemed to hold its breath. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul watched him worriedly, his shadow growing ever fainter, as if it might dissipate at any moment. The silence lasted a long time. Long enough that the Eye of Heavenly Dao's意念 produced subtle fluctuations,似乎在puzzled his reaction. Finally, Chen Ji opened his eyes. In those eyes was not the anger or despair it had anticipated, only a calmness reaching the bottomless depths—and beneath that calm, a fire of fury sufficient to ignite the plains. "I understand." His voice was very light, as if speaking to himself. "So you need me, need Chen Nian, need this entire chess game to reach the endgame according to your script. Then allow me to ask—" he raised his head, staring directly at a direction in the void, "what if I don't follow the script?"

text.content: In Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the impending fury was suppressed by him. Not from fear, but from reason. "I understand." His voice returned to its usualplain. "Since you need my cooperation, I will cooperate. But I have one condition—let me see Chen Nian first." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's意念 fluctuated for a moment,似乎在scrutinizing his true intent. After a brief while, that pressure receded like a tide. "A wise choice." Its voice faded. "Within three days, you will receive an answer."

choices.description: Even if crushed to dust, I will tear apart this chessboard that has shrouded me for eighteen years.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing all trump cards may bring devastating retaliation.
choices.visible_reward: May gain Mo Xiansheng's full support, unlocking the hidden layer of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: Directly confronting the Heavenly Eye leaves almost zero chance of victory.

text.content: "Cooperate?" Chen Ji suddenly laughed wildly toward the sky, his laughter filled with sorrow and madness. "I, Chen Ji, have schemed my entire life, never willing to be beneath anyone. You want me as a key? Very well—first ask my life if it agrees!" He urgently activated the Tianji Record, the fragment erupting with dazzling light—he wagered all his Heavenly Fate Value to glimpse a thread of possibility to break the局. Mo Xiansheng was horrified: "Don't!" But Chen Ji could no longer listen. Within the light, he saw a blurry scene—within the depths of the Tianji Record, there seemed to be a layer of forbidden restriction never before activated.

choices.description: Since the rules are known, then use them—turn the scheme against itself, making its layout serve my purpose.
choices.visible_cost: Under tremendous psychological pressure, requiring constant disguise
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Heavenly Eye's resource favoritism, using the enemy's blade to kill
choices.risk_hint: Slight carelessness may result in backlash, with unknown cost

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing the dark currents churning in his gaze. "You are right." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Since I was a chess piece from the start, I shall fulfill a chess piece's duty—but chess pieces have their uses too." A hint of imperceptible mockery laced his tone. The Heavenly Eye's will flickered slightly, as if sensing something, but soon receded satisfied. Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji, his expression complex: "You plan to..." Chen Ji replied indifferently: "It wants me as a key, so I'll be one. What it doesn't know is that a key can also cut the hand that holds it."
